tasks.short: Enter shipping information by hand or scanner

steps.what: Identify the goods and enter shipping information using the existing scanner or keyboard
Check captured shipping information and resolve unreadable labels or missing fields

tasks.design: Retain identification, scanning or keyboard entry and exception checks in {OPS_SYSTEM}. Existing barcode decoding is already automated and does not create a new labour saving; the agent must still match the label to the actual goods.
tasks.previous_blocker: Unreadable labels and incomplete documents require physical and documentary checks.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing scanners already reduce character entry where labels are usable.
tasks.still_hard: Wrong labels, uncertain goods identity and missing shipment data.
tasks.human_edge: Recognising when a valid barcode belongs to the wrong item.
tasks.altitude: The agent's capture and checking responsibility remains unchanged.

reach.task: Resolve an ambiguous shipment identifier before processing

evidence.claim: Existing barcode decoding does not remove the operator's physical identification and exception work or establish incremental labour savings.

assumptions: Boundary is initial shipping-data entry and checking, excluding separate consolidated goods-register upkeep. A roll-up assigns any shared capture once.

The existing shipper or packing process supplies labels and shipping documents before s1. The agent captures shipment and handling-unit IDs and the required shipping fields in s1 and checks them in s2; no free structured feed is assumed.
Unreadable or inconsistent labels require manual entry and source clarification within retained time. Scanning does not prove physical contents or quantity.
Native scanner configuration is the first option and already present in this scenario; no custom build is proposed.
Zero incremental upkeep because the existing capture process remains unchanged.
unknowns: Label quality and required shipping fields
research_questions: Which entry effort is not already removed by existing barcode capture?

already_counted.description: Identification, capture and exception checks remain fully counted

incremental.description: No changed process or tool to maintain

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross and net saving 0. Existing scanning runtime is excluded and physical identification and entry exceptions remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Check passenger counts and baggage, mail and freight weights for the aircraft manifest
Prepare manifests from checked passenger counts and component weight records
Verify the exact manifest and transmit it to the confirmed destination
Check manifest transmission status and resolve late changes or failed delivery

tasks.design: Configure a native manifest template in {OPS_SYSTEM} from checked counts and component weights. The agent reviews the exact final document, transmits it to the confirmed destination and handles acknowledgement and late changes; this does not automate loading acceptance or flight release.
tasks.previous_blocker: Separate source records may be retyped and arranged into a destination manifest.
tasks.enabler_now: Deterministic document generation can reuse checked source fields without generating operational facts.
tasks.still_hard: Late load changes, inconsistent units and matching the correct aircraft and flight version.
tasks.human_edge: Recognising when the source records do not describe the actual flight.
tasks.altitude: The agent may format fewer manifests manually while retaining content and transmission responsibility.

reach.task: Reconcile manifest revisions with source load records
reach.learn: Version control and load-document responsibility boundaries

evidence.claim: Generating a manifest from checked counts and weights is a plausible deterministic configuration; this exact aircraft-manifest implementation and saving are unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary is manifest preparation and transmission, excluding passenger check-in, baggage weighing, load control, weight-and-balance approval and flight release.

Before s1, the existing passenger-handling process produces the count record, baggage handling produces baggage weights, and mail/freight handling produces component weights. Those existing physical capture tasks are unchanged, not new free labour.

In s1 the agent verifies or manually captures flight/date, aircraft ID, origin/destination, passenger count, baggage/mail/freight component weights, units, source references, timestamps and versions, plus destination contact and required manifest format. All checking and missing-field capture are counted in s1.
No passenger count or weight is inferred from bookings. Incomplete or conflicting records require manual preparation; s2 only copies and totals checked values with explicit units.

The destination produces its response after s3 before s4, and handling staff may produce late changes after transmission. Any changed manifest requires renewed exact-version review and transmission, included in retained exception work and upkeep.

Test native manifest generation before custom integration; existing automatic generation earns zero new saving. Allow 7 focal hours per 100 baseline for template changes and generation faults, plus 2 other-role hours for interface upkeep.
unknowns: Current source records and manual formatting workload
Required manifest formats and destination response channels
research_questions: Does generation save time after source capture, unit checking, revision review and failed-transmission handling?

already_counted.description: Source checking and missing-field capture remain counted
Manifest review, transmission and response handling remain counted

incremental.description: Maintain manifest formats and resolve generation faults

approvals.approved_version: Exact aircraft manifest version, flight/date, source snapshot and destination recipient; any changed count, weight or destination voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=70; gross saving 30 less 7 focal upkeep gives net 23. Range 4-14 assumes manual formatting and retyping remain, with frequent revisions and source inconsistencies reducing returns; already generated manifests gain zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Clarify goods, value, journey and customer insurance requirements
Arrange insurance coverage through the authorised process and confirm coverage evidence

tasks.design: Keep requirements clarification and coverage arrangement with authorised people using {EMAIL} or {PARTNER_PORTAL}. The agent verifies the provider's actual response and explains unresolved questions; a generated summary is not treated as coverage confirmation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Coverage depends on actual cargo, terms, exclusions and authority to arrange it.
tasks.enabler_now: No supported change removes this judgement and coordination in the stated task.
tasks.still_hard: Unclear declared values, special goods, exclusions and uncertain provider acceptance.
tasks.human_edge: Recognising when the customer's request requires provider clarification or specialist advice.
tasks.altitude: The agent retains the same arrangement responsibilities and does not gain underwriting authority.

reach.task: Gather a complete coverage enquiry for the authorised provider
reach.learn: Cargo facts, disclosure requirements and referral boundaries

evidence.claim: Insurance arrangement requires confirmed requirements, applicable terms and provider evidence; no supported automation or labour saving is asserted here.

assumptions: Boundary is the agent's authorised arrangement work, excluding underwriting, broker advice requiring separate authority and claims handling.

The customer supplies existing shipment facts and requested cover before s1. The agent clarifies goods, value/currency, route, dates and requested scope in s1; capture time stays counted and no structured insurance brief is assumed free.

The provider produces applicable terms and its response during s2 after receiving the checked requirements. The agent's review and any authorised placement are counted in s2; unresolved conditions require manual clarification, not inferred coverage.
Test existing provider forms before custom tools if duplicate-entry work is separately established; no new software is proposed.
Zero incremental upkeep because the current authorised arrangement process is unchanged.
research_questions: Which part of arrangement effort is repeatable entry rather than terms clarification and authorised decision-making?

already_counted.description: Requirements clarification and authorised arrangement remain fully counted

incremental.description: No changed process or tool to maintain

approvals.approved_version: Exact insurance arrangement, goods/value/journey, provider terms, customer mandate and communicated coverage evidence; any change requires renewed authorised review

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross and net saving 0. The scenario retains actual requirements and coverage coordination without inventing an automatable administration share.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Check cargo documents and classify tariff group

steps.what: Read import or export documentation and extract stated cargo contents with source passages

loop.purpose: Extract stated cargo facts without deciding the tariff classification
loop.input: Supplied import or export documents for the identified shipment
loop.output: Draft cargo fact sheet with quoted source passages and explicit missing or conflicting facts
loop.check: Agent compares composition, function, quantities and identifying descriptions against the actual document passages and checks that uncertainty is preserved
loop.stop: One extraction and one correction; conflicting descriptions or missing material facts require manual review and shipper clarification
loop.why_not_simpler: Use native structured document fields first; varied free-text cargo descriptions may require a bounded extraction loop

steps.what: Use the tariff coding system to determine the supported fee or tariff group
Check and record the classification rationale or refer unresolved classification questions

tasks.design: A bounded loop in {DOCS} prepares a source-linked cargo fact sheet from the supplied documents. The agent checks the facts, uses {OTHER}, the tariff reference system, and records or refers the classification in {OPS_SYSTEM}; extraction assistance does not choose the tariff group or file a declaration.
tasks.previous_blocker: Cargo facts may be scattered through inconsistent documents, while the classification still needs interpretation.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-linked text extraction is plausible with full review and a manual fallback.
tasks.still_hard: Incomplete composition or intended-use information and competing classification interpretations.
tasks.human_edge: Recognising missing material facts and obtaining specialist clarification rather than accepting a plausible code.
tasks.altitude: The agent may assemble documentary facts faster but retains classification reasoning and referral responsibilities.

reach.task: Prepare a source-linked fact pack for classification review
reach.learn: Material classification facts and escalation boundaries

evidence.claim: Bounded extraction of stated cargo facts is plausible; its classification-specific accuracy and time saving remain unmeasured.
The digest reports high unchanged acceptance of top tariff suggestions in a vendor case; this supports guarding against uncritical acceptance, not a claim of correct classification.

assumptions: Boundary is documentary fact review and the agent's classification work, excluding customs declaration submission, binding rulings and specialist work outside the agent's authority.

The shipper supplies existing import/export documents before s1. The agent selects the shipment documents, extracts or checks product identifiers, descriptions, composition and function where stated, quantities/units and source passages in s1. Document selection, capture, correction and missing-fact clarification remain within its retained time.

No structured contents description or pre-approved tariff code is assumed free. Missing material facts stop classification and are referred rather than invented. OTHER means an existing tariff reference system maintained by its normal reference publisher.
Use native structured document fields and existing tariff tools before a custom loop. Existing lookup runtime and any previous automatic classification earn no saving.

Allow 6 focal hours per 100 baseline for extraction instructions, document-format exceptions and sample audits. The design adds no mandatory specialist review beyond existing unresolved-case referrals; additional required review would reduce savings.
unknowns: Agent classification authority and referral process
research_questions: Does source-linked extraction save time after checking composition, function and uncertainty against the documents?

already_counted.description: Document selection, extraction review and factual clarification remain counted
Classification reasoning and final record/referral remain fully counted

incremental.description: Maintain extraction instructions and audit document exceptions

approvals.approved_version: Exact shipment fact-sheet version, source documents, tariff reference version, chosen group and rationale or referral; changed facts or code require renewed review

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=88; gross saving 12 less 6 upkeep gives net 6. Range 0-4 assumes document-fact extraction saves some reading effort but difficult descriptions and full classification judgement remain; unsuitable documents return to manual review.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Manifest formatting and source-linked document extraction may take less time; physical entry checks, insurance coordination and tariff judgement remain accountable human work.
reach: Prepare stronger classification fact packs for specialists
Reconcile manifest versions with cargo handlers
skills_to_grow: Knowing limits of insurance and classification authority
role.ambitious_version: Prepare reliable operational records and clearer specialist referrals without treating plausible generated data as confirmed cargo facts.
